scheme.title: Climate Data Hub Commodity Vocabulary
scheme.description: Controlled vocabulary of crops and livestock used by the Climate Data Hub for metadata filtering and catalog browse. Crops are generated from the FAO Indicative Crop Classification 1.1 and livestock from the WCA 2030 Classification of livestock; each concept carries its source code, ancestor ids for roll-up under `crops` or `livestock`, and an AGROVOC URI where one corresponds.
